issues.description: `PersonResource.updatePerson(...)` has a different parameter order between template and solution: the template declares `updatePerson(@RequestBody Person updatedPerson, @PathVariable("personId") Long personId)`, while the solution declares `updatePerson(@PathVariable("personId") Long personId, @RequestBody Person updatedPerson)`. This can confuse students when comparing controller code against the reference and may cause unnecessary merge conflicts when syncing template and solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the `updatePerson` method signature identical in template and solution (same parameter order and annotation placement). Prefer keeping the template signature and updating the solution to match, or vice versa.

issues.description: The problem statement requires students to adapt and run a deployment build script (`build.sh` on Linux/Mac or `build.bat` on Windows), but neither the template nor the solution repository contains these files. This makes the described deployment workflow impossible to follow as written.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `build.sh` and `build.bat` to the template (with TODOs/placeholders) and include completed versions in the solution, or update the problem statement to reference the actual provided script(s) if they exist under different names.
